The '''{{zone|Graveyard}}''' is a [[Location]] on the [[Hub Island]] found past the {{Zone|Combat Settlement}} that features low-level {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s and a portal to the {{Zone|Spider's Den}}.

{{ZoneText|Fight Zombies.|Travel to the &cSpider's Den&f.|Talk to &7Pat&f.|Investigate the Catacombs.}}

== Purpose ==
The {{zone|Graveyard}} is home to {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s, which spawn in during the day, and more frequently at night. Additionally, {{MobSprite|Zombie Villager}}s that spawn exclusively and frequently at night.

The back of the '''Graveyard''' contains a launch pad to the {{zone|Spider's Den}}. There are also entrances to the {{Zone|Crypts}}, {{Zone|Catacombs Entrance}}, and {{Zone|Coal Mine}}.

=== Pat's House ===
[[File:Pat's House.png|thumb|Pat's House]]
There is a house near the entrance with {{NPCSprite|Pat}} inside who sells {{Item|Flint}} and {{Item|Gravel}}.

=== Emerald Altar ===
[[File:Emerald Altar.png|thumb|The Emerald Altar]]
The '''Emerald Altar''' is a mysterious altar located in the Graveyard. It consists of {{Item|Block of Emerald|amount=2|link=}} and {{Item|Lime Stained Glass|link=}}, making a spire in the center of 8 wide pillars surrounding the spire and thus making the altar. 

When the player tries to destroy the emerald block, the following message appears:
{{Dialogue|&cThe altar doesn't budge!}}

{{NPCSprite|Romero}} is found standing next to it during the 3rd phase of his quest, where he gives you the {{Item|Fake Emerald Altar}}.

=== Dante Memorial ===
[[File:Dante Memorial.png|thumb|The Dante Memorial]]
A memorial to {{NPCSprite|Dante}} exists at {{Coordinates|-84|76|-152}}. The stone pillar structure was added into the game during the 0.8.1 Hub revamp, while the {{NPCSprite|Dante}} statue and the memorial itself was added after [[The Uprising]]. Upon interaction with the stone statue of Dante, the following chat message appears:

<!-- Spelling errors are INTENTIONAL, as they appear so in-game!
-->{{Dialogue|
&7In Memoriam
&fWhile Dante will be remembered as a cruel tyrant, his righteous ideals live on in people's hearts.
&fdante &6best&7.
}}
